# DotOS v3.0.1

A stability hotfix on top of [v3.0.0](https://github.com/Holrigue/DotOS-T-Watch-Ultra-Firmware/releases/tag/v3.0.0). Same features — install **DotOS Phone Link v3.0.0** on the phone alongside it.

## Flash
Open the one-click web flasher (link below) in Chrome or Edge and click **Install**,
or download the four `.bin` files and `DotOS-v3.0.1-flasher.html` from the assets.

> **Coming from v3.0.0?** Do a **full-erase** flash this once. The crash below
> corrupted the saved Bluetooth bonding data; erasing clears it. Your SD-card
> settings (favorites, step goal, vibration) are on the card and survive. After
> flashing, forget the watch in your phone's Bluetooth and pair again.

## What's fixed
- **No more black-screen crash when switching Notify between iOS and Android.**
  Toggling the notification platform a few times — especially with a detector
  (e.g. Flock) running — used to crash the watch, and the saved state replayed
  the crash on every boot (logo, then black). The notification stacks and the
  detectors now **share** the Bluetooth radio instead of each tearing it down
  under the other.
- **Detectors keep scanning while notifications are on.** They used to go
  silently blind whenever Notify was active.
- **Notify comes back by itself after a reboot.** The saved on/off state was
  never actually being restored; you had to re-enable it by hand every time.

## If a v3.0.0 watch is stuck on a black screen
Power it fully off and on a few times: the boot guard enters a safe start after
two bad boots (skipping the restore that crashed) and wipes the saved settings
after four. A full-erase flash of this build fixes it outright.
